admission.justification: A module docstring naming a shipped release candidate dates the guidance to a version that no longer exists; a maintainer would read a false current account, so the statement guards that plausible mistake.

conditions: The docstring describes the failure class the preflight guards.
exclusions: Historical release notes and captured test strings.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_standalone_master_retirement.py -m integration: 33 passed, including the case that patches serving_preflight.SubTaskRef

statement: The serving preflight's module documentation describes the failure class it guards against without naming a release candidate.
